rows.value: The Rumble of The Rain River

[The Rumble of The Rain River]

Oh, it's you?
I was just looking for you. This morning a tremendous noise woke me up, and what did I see? A huge chunk of stone standing right there.
I wondered who had brought it in the night, so I rubbed my eyes and took a closer look. It was a golem made of solid rock!
As it kept stomping around, the monsters nearby all fled in terror.
A few passing adventurers joined forces and attacked it, but they were knocked down in no time.

To tell the truth, I haven't seen a golem in a very long time. What matters is why it suddenly appeared in the Rein River area. 
Hmm, I'm really worried. Once before, not long after a golem appeared, a terrible disaster struck the Kingdom of Alpen.

Would you go and see Clark, the warehouse keeper in Alpen?
I think we should find out what Clark's books have to say.

Clark has been collecting old books for a long time, and a few of them describe in detail the monsters that appeared in the past.

Clark can probably tell you more about the golem.
You must go and see Clark, the warehouse keeper in Alpen.

[Darkness Corps]

If so, the Darkness Corps... No, no.
In Alpen it is forbidden to even speak of the Darkness Corps. And as the warehouse keeper of Alpen, I must never say those words.
Instead, I'll give you a book about the Darkness Corps. Take it to Ben.

Ben lives in the Rein River area, so he can talk about the Darkness Corps without breaking Alpen law.
You must go and see Ben at the lower part of the Rein River.

[Punish Monalise]

(Ben blows the dust off the old book, opens it with a tense face and starts reading.)

Hmm, just as I feared.
Making a golem is very hard work. The only ones who can make them are the Darkness Corps... the Deckron Army. 
In other words, if a golem has appeared, the Deckron Army has begun to move......
......
So the day has finally come... Heh heh heh...
Well, an old man like me can die without regrets, but I worry about young folks like you...

Yes, yes......
As long as there are brave young people like you, what is there to fear, even if the Deckron Army - no, even Deckron's grandfather's army - comes. Heh~

Luckily, if you can call it that, the golem made now is of the lowest rank.
That means the Deckron Army is still barely moving. 

I think you should give the Deckron Army a little welcome. Do you know what I mean? 
Go beyond the Penol Bridge, defeat the golem and bring me proof.

But there is one thing you must keep in mind.
I know you are skilled, but a golem is never an opponent you can face alone.
Understood?
Never try to fight it alone. You must join forces with other adventurers.
You must defeat the golem Monalise beyond the Penol Bridge and get the proof.
Once you have the proof, go see Ben at the lower part of the Rein River.

[Crucial Information]

Welcome. 
I was just looking for you. You are the only one who can do this.

I have received urgent news that something terrible is happening in Conquest Land.
But honestly, I can't believe it.
Those who could create them vanished from this world long ago.

But... if it is true, we must be ready to fight with everything we have built so far.

Ah!
There's no time to waste.
I'll write a letter. Please deliver it to Radmil in Alpen. 

Radmil will know whether this news is true or not. Please hurry.

[Dark Creation]

......
So it has finally come. I heard rumors that the same thing happened at the Rein River...

Hey. You!
Listen carefully to what I'm about to say.
Elosa says that dark creations have appeared in Conquest Land. And Elosa is asking me whether that is really possible.
Yes. Dark creations can appear in Conquest Land.
The signs have already shown up many times.
But the Kingdom must never find out about this. 

If the Kingdom learns of it... the consequences would be beyond words.
And if it ever reaches the ears of Knight Captain Ella, there will be a terrible battle.

I want to handle this as quietly as possible.
Of course, Elosa thinks the same. 
The priests and soldiers, Ella included, have no idea how dangerous they are.

There's no time. I'll write you a letter. Deliver it to Elosa.

This must be done in strict secrecy. Remember that. Understood?
You must go and see Elosa in Silaris.

[Punish Ocsodogs]

Before you begin, there is something you should know.
What has appeared in Conquest Land are creations of the Darkness Corps, the Deckron Army. In other words, the Deckron Army has started to move.

But Alpen must not learn of this yet.
Facing them before we have built up our strength would be far too reckless. 

Yes. The soldiers may find them. 
If soldiers who find them report it to their superiors, the Kingdom will do something reckless and fight them. 

That is why I need you.
Fortunately, those dark creations, the Ocsodog golems, are not yet at full strength.

Go to Conquest Land now and destroy them before the Kingdom notices, then come back. Understood?
You must find and defeat the golem Ocsodogs in Conquest Land and get the proof.
Once you have the proof, go see Elosa in Silaris.

[Offering Event Shovel]

Hello!

Are you enjoying the game? Hoho.

I'd like to tell you how to have even more fun in Asda Story.

Are you interested?

[How to Build Barracks?]

Hey [NAME]! If you're not busy, give me a hand! 
Alpen told me to build more barracks. Looks like they plan to set up a big forward base here. 
I've thought it over, 
and to build barracks you really need to use your head to place them right. 
But I'm just a soldier, right? 
We'll never manage to build barracks. Probably...

Oh! If you help me, I'll feel much better! 
First we have to move the barracks, so we need to pull out the big nails that hold them in place. 
But I have no tool to pull the nails out. Could you borrow one from Ben? 
I'll hold the barracks ropes. If I let go, the wind might blow the barracks away. 
Please!

Go to Ben and borrow a tool for pulling out the nails.

▶Ben -Rein River x: 58, y:339

Ben gave you a hammer. Take the hammer back to Vasa.

▶Vasa -Rein River x:288 y:243

[Don't Hatch the Pet]

Oh! You've brought a really cute wolf cub! 
Now... we have to put this wolf cub into a Dream Crystal Egg to make it tamer. 
Otherwise it will become a wild Pet. 
Usually when you're hunting monsters, you'll find baby monsters like this inside Dream Crystal Eggs. 
And how do you hatch a baby monster that has become an egg? You hatch it with an Incubator.
But keep in mind that a Pet Egg can break.

I'll put your Pet into the Dream Crystal Egg too, so try hatching it. 
Of course, I'll give you the Incubator for saving my Pet. Let's hatch them together.

Now. Open the Pet Incubator I gave you, put the Pet Egg inside and hatch it, and the Pet will come out. 
After hatching the Pet, talk to me again. It's fine if you don't hatch the Pet, though.

Hm?

Hmm... 
If you don't want to hatch the Pet, there's nothing I can do.
You can raise many Pets. So don't worry about which Pet to raise - just pick the one that suits you.

[Wendy’s Request]

Umm, if you’re not busy, could you do me a favor?

Although I cannot fight anymore, I used to fight in the battlefield.
But after I was seriously injured while helping Silaris, I couldn’t fight anymore.
And my favorite magic bow was stolen by the monsters.
I’ve heard that the arms/armor dealer Yajark in Silaris found some pieces of my magic bow.
Could you find out about it?

Thank you. I’ll be waiting for you.
